author: Benzo_
quote: The game falls far short of expectations, especially considering its reported 13-year development cycle and $2 billion budget. Despite its massive file size, the gameplay is surprisingly shallow and repetitive. Missions revolve around mundane activities like grocery shopping, fixing roofs, and painting walls. NPC interactions feel lifeless, animations are poorly implemented, and character models lack variety. The story is unnecessarily stretched out with filler missions, while exploration quickly becomes boring, offering little incentive to discover the world. Performance is another major disappointment. The game struggles to maintain 30 FPS, with frequent drops, stuttering, and poor optimization. Finally, the PS5 and Xbox exclusivity, leaving PC players behind, feels like a commercially motivated decision to maximize profits rather than serve the entire player base. Overall, the game disappoints in almost every aspect. Given its enormous budget and development time, these shortcomings are unacceptable.
